Featured · Capstone project

Clinique Physio Mont-Royal

Secure booking and patient platform for a physiotherapy clinic. One API serves three clients: a patient website, a front-desk desktop app and a patient mobile app. Built as the capstone of the Software Development AEC at Vanier College in one-week Agile sprints.

  • Online booking with no double booking, guaranteed by a database constraint
  • Argon2id passwords, rotating refresh tokens and mandatory two-factor login for staff
  • Card payments and refunds with Stripe; bilingual French and English
